newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CNA Gallo to announce buys - sources.
newsitem.headline: CNA Gallo to announce buys - sources.

text.p: South African leisure firm and retailer CNA Gallo Ltd is to announce a set of acquisitions when it posts its year results next month, industry sources said.
"They have made some acquisitions and they want to include those in their annual report," one source said.

The firm had sealed the unspecified deals near the end of its last financial period and wants to include the details of the moves with its year results. This means the figures will be released on May 27, several weeks later than usual, the source added.
A company spokeswoman declined to comment on any deals.
CNA Gallo in January sealed a tie-up with fast growing confectioner Sweets From Heaven Ltd that will see Heaven franchise its outlets within CNA branches and Nu Metro cinema complexes.
